legacyHistorical.rationale: The saved raw dataset metadata does not preserve original NASA POWER request parameters, and the API defaults to LST; tz:-5 alone does not verify civil-time alignment. Do not silently convert it.

legacyTypicalYear.source: PVWatts V8 API NSRDB PSM V3 typical-year
legacyTypicalYear.caveat: Typical-year synthesis is not a chronological weather history and must not be interpreted as a particular past winter.

testsRequired: Original request URL and processing revision preserved for each future weather import
One-hour mean irradiance integrated without artificial linear interpolation
No mixing of UTC, local solar time and civil local time without explicit conversion
Leap-day deletion and 120-day winter boundaries validated as deliberate sampling transforms
SHA256 of original source response and normalized arrays in provenance records
